title: Eilenberg's inequality for the unnormalized Hausdorff measure on an arbitrary metric space (constant 2)
statement: Let X be an extended metric space whose measurable structure is its Borel σ-algebra, m ∈ ℕ, f : X → ℝ, L ∈ [0, ∞) and A ⊆ X such that f is L-Lipschitz on A. Then there is a Borel function ψ : ℝ → [0, ∞] with μH[m](A ∩ f⁻¹{t}) ≤ ψ(t) for every t ∈ ℝ and ∫_ℝ ψ dλ¹ ≤ 2L·μH[m+1](A). Here μH[k] is Mathlib's unnormalized k-dimensional Hausdorff measure on X, evaluated as an outer measure on arbitrary sets, and λ¹ is Lebesgue measure on ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (m : ℕ) (f : X → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (A : Set X), LipschitzOnWith L f A → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable ψ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, (μH[(m : ℝ)] : Measure X) (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ ψ t) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ψ t ≤ 2 * (L : ℝ≥0∞) * (μH[((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)] : Measure X) A
